data.subject: PCB, FRST, and ISTR in your 13F
data.body:
Hi,

Maltese Capital Management LLC's most recent 13F, for the period ended June 30, 2026, shows positions in PCB, FRST, and ISTR.

On September 24, 2026, PCB disclosed a director or officer change in an 8-K Item 5.02 filing (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1423869/000142386926000029/pcb-20260923.htm).

I publish a free weekly issue on public-records research and can offer a four-week fund pilot. Reply 'no' and I won't follow up.
